category: Version and update control for the apps of a self-hosted Nextcloud instance: an admin tool that lists every published version of an installed app from the App Store and from Git forges (GitHub, Codeberg), installs any older or newer version with pre-flight, migration and checksum guards, pins versions and detects drift, runs per-app automatic update policies inside a maintenance window behind a global kill switch, correlates installed versions with security advisories, and keeps an audit trail. It competes with the platform's own app management and update notifications, with dependency update bots (Renovate, Dependabot), with vulnerability scanners that match versions against advisory feeds (OSV-Scanner), and with in-platform update managers of other plugin ecosystems (Easy Updates Manager for WordPress).

capabilities.name: Run fully on premises without a SaaS dependency.
capabilities.note: Runs inside the Nextcloud instance with no SaaS dependency; it does call the public App Store, GitHub and Codeberg APIs unless their base URLs are overridden.

evidence.nextcloud: Runs on the instance; the store and update server URLs can point at self-hosted mirrors (config/config.sample.php:980,1408).
evidence.renovate: The OSS CLI and Docker image run fully self-hosted against GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, Forgejo, Gitea, Bitbucket Server and more (docs/usage/getting-started/running.md; lib/modules/platform).
evidence.dependabot: GitHub Enterprise Server runs Dependabot on premises but needs GitHub Connect for the advisory sync (https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-server@latest/admin/configuring-settings/configuring-github-connect/enabling-dependabot-for-your-enterprise); core with the open CLI can be self-hosted (README.md:48, README.md:57).
evidence.osv-scanner: Runs locally; ,offline sends no project or dependency information anywhere (docs/offline-mode.md:273).
evidence.easy-updates-manager: A WordPress plugin running on the site; premium only contacts the vendor for its own licence and updates (readme.txt changelog 9.0.18 names the plugin-update-checker package used by premium; the free zip ships only vendor/team-updraft notices and a polyfill).

evidence.dependabot: The Free plan includes Dependabot alerts, security updates and version updates (https://github.com/pricing); custom auto-triage rules on private repositories and licence policies need GitHub Code Security (https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/concepts/supply-chain-security/dependabot-auto-triage-rules, https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/how-tos/secure-your-supply-chain/manage-your-dependency-security/configure-license-policies).

evidence.easy-updates-manager: Scheduling, delay, safe mode, backups, log export and search, external logging and pending-update reports are premium, from $29 a year (https://easyupdatesmanager.com/buy/).

built.evidence: no MCP server or assistant integration under lib/ or src/

capabilities.note: No AI assistant or MCP surface.

evidence.nextcloud: Nothing in server v34.0.4's apps management or updatenotification code exposes version or advisory data to an assistant or an MCP server (apps/appstore, apps/updatenotification). Nextcloud's AI apps (assistant, context agent) are separate apps outside this repo, and no advisory data exists for them to explain.
evidence.renovate: Renovate ships no AI assistant or MCP server; the only MCP server listed is the third-party renovate-config-debugger for config debugging (docs/usage/community-tools.md:63), not advisory checks.
